Overview

Bismarck is a city in ND with a population of 74,000. North Dakota’s capital on the Missouri River with the State Capitol and Fort Abraham Lincoln. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 4a growing zone supports Cold — cool-season crops, hardy perennials. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
